Signed-off-by: Yongqin Wang <yongqinwang@roblox.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/pp_utils.py (SpecPPSupport, resolve_spec_pp_support, bypass_upstream_spec_pp_guard, restore_pp_after_upstream_init, make_empty_intermediate_tensors with _PP_TRANSPORT_PREFIX)
vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py (NPUModelRunner extends GPUModelRunner; init PP-bypass, install_spec_pp_token_broadcast, execute_model/sample_tokens draft broadcast)
vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_eagle3_pp_aux.py (wraps inner model forward/make_empty_intermediate_tensors for aux relay)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit natively implements what vllm-ascend had hacked in for MRV2 spec decode + PP (Eagle3/DSpark), and it breaks the Ascend workaround path. Required adaptations: (1) PPHandler contract: upstream GPUModelRunner.execute_model now calls pp_handler.get_prev_sampled_outputs(self.req_states.draft_tokens), pp_handler.broadcast_drafts(...), pp_handler.configure_aux_hidden_state_relay(model) and relay_aux_hidden_states(...). vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_spec_pp.py overrides get_prev_sampled_outputs with a zero-arg closure and mutates max_sample_len to carry a combined sampled+draft payload; both break (TypeError, double draft broadcast) against the new signatures and the new separate draft broadcast in PPHandler.receive(). Rework patch_spec_pp to the new API or drop it in favor of upstream broadcast_drafts/draft_tokens-in-PendingRecv. (2) Aux hidden-state relay: upstream adds EagleModelMixin.pack_local_aux_hidden_states/collect_remote_aux_hidden_states (AUX_HIDDEN_STATE_KEY), PPHandler.relay_aux_hidden_states, reserve_aux_intermediate_tensor_slots and requires supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp=True. vllm-ascend's EagleModelMixin subclasses (DeepseekV4Model, KimiLinearModel, MiniMaxM3Model) must set the flag and implement the pack/collect contract, and vllm_ascend/worker/v2/pp_utils.make_empty_intermediate_tensors / patch/worker/patch_eagle3_pp_aux.py (its own _PP_TRANSPORT_PREFIX keys) must be reconciled/removed to avoid KeyError/duplicate transport. verify_supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp will otherwise raise ValueError on NPU since none of the Ascend models set the new class attribute. (3) Config/guards: upstream removed the EAGLE3+PP unsupported check in vllm/config/vllm.py and the model_runner ValueError, and SpeculativeConfig.draft_parallel_config now forces pipeline_parallel_size=1. Re-evaluate/retire bypass_upstream_spec_pp_guard + restore_pp_after_upstream_init in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/pp_utils.py and NPUModelRunner.__init__, and patch_dspark's get_pp_group/_should_share stubbing. (4) Embed sharing: new spec_decode_needs_target_embed (vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py) adds embed_tokens on the last PP rank, and maybe_share_target_embed (eagle/utils.py) now runs under PP with PPMissingLayer/LoRA-base handling. Align vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/model.py and kimi_k3.py embed construction, and recheck qwen3_dspark.py/kimi_k3_dspark.py has_own_embed_tokens=True logic against the new loader flow. (5) Layer counts: update kimi_k3_dspark.py and llama_eagle3_vwn.py to get_total_num_hidden_layers() (matches the Eagle3 PP fix now upstream). (6) Tests: tests/ut/patch/worker/test_patch_eagle3_pp_aux.py, tests/ut/models/test_kimi_k3_adapter.py and test_deepseek_v4_vision.py exercise the old mixin/_set_aux_hidden_state_layers behavior (now sorts/dedups + caches PP layout) and need updates.
deep_analysis.risk: High. The overlap is crash-level, not cosmetic: the zero-arg get_prev_sampled_outputs override TypeErrors on the new upstream call; missing supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp triggers ValueError during load_model; the new relay path reads aux_hidden_states_ keys that the Ascend _PP_TRANSPORT_PREFIX forward never packs (KeyError); draft tokens would be broadcast twice (Ascend packed payload vs upstream broadcast_drafts/draft_tokens tensor) and the broadcast() pad-to-max_sample_len logic collides with the Ascend max_sample_len mutation. Embed-sharing semantics under PP changed (draft may now raise RuntimeError if target embed is missing on last rank), and draft_parallel_config PP size semantics changed. Because this affects the actively-gated MiniMaxM3 Eagle3 and DeepSeek-V4 DSpark + PP paths, any naive rebase breaks spec+PP serving; a careful reconciliation of the two aux-transport and draft-broadcast mechanisms plus model-flag adoption is required, with revalidation of e2e Eagle3/DSpark PP on NPU.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit's gpu_worker.py reordering does not apply directly (NPUWorker overrides compile_or_warm_up_model), but NPUModelRunnerV2 inherits GPUModelRunner.capture_model which now calls lock_workspace() from vllm.v1.worker.workspace after a real capture. Adapt: (1) In vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py compile_or_warm_up_model, ensure the workspace reaches its scheduler-realistic max size BEFORE self.model_runner.capture_model() (line 785), e.g. by running the equivalent of upstream warmup_kernels (full execute_model + sample_tokens) before capture - vllm-ascend currently only runs _dummy_run + its own kernel_warmup, so if the first runtime batch needs a bigger workspace than reserved during warmup it will now raise the new 'Workspace is locked' AssertionError. (2) Confirm init_workspace_manager (worker.py:489) is always called before capture in the V2 path and that post-capture growth is not needed (check apply_top_k_top_p workspace reservation note in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/apply_top_k_top_p.py, spec-decode workspace lanes, elastic EP). (3) Optionally add 'profile_only: bool = False' to NPUModelRunner.capture_model in vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py and pass it through, to stay compatible if vllm-ascend ever adopts upstream profile_cudagraph_memory (which now calls capture_model(profile_only=True)).
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. If the V2 warmup does not reserve the maximum runtime workspace before capture, the newly inherited lock_workspace() in capture_model will turn previously-silent workspace resizes into hard AssertionErrors at runtime. The lock also interacts with vllm-ascend's known workspace-reservation quirk (apply_top_k_top_p) and any post-capture growth in sleep/wake (sleep_mem_optimized.py:128 calls capture_model again, re-locking is idempotent but re-capture under a locked workspace must not need growth). deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit ([1/2][Model Runner V2] DBO support, eager mode) adds Dual Batch Overlap support to the V2 GPU model runner in eager mode. DBO remains disabled on Ascend today (AscendPlatform.check_and_update_config resets enable_dbo=False and ubatch_size=0, so ParallelConfig.use_ubatching is always False, UBatchRunner is never built, and no runtime path breaks). The required adaptation is interface syncing:

1. Add `ubatch_idx: int = 0` to every `prepare_attn` override so it matches the new abstract signature in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/interface.py:
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py (AscendModelState.prepare_attn) - accept ubatch_idx and forward it to build_attn_metadata.
   - vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/mamba_hybrid.py (AscendMambaHybridModelState.prepare_attn) - add the param and assert `ubatch_idx == 0, "DBO is not supported"`, mirroring upstream MambaHybridModelState.
   - vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_state.py (Ascend310PModelState/Ascend310PMambaHybridModelState.prepare_attn) - add the param and pass it through to super().
2. In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py, update build_attn_metadata to accept `ubatch_idx: int = 0` and replace the hardcoded `attn_group.get_metadata_builder(0)` with `attn_group.get_metadata_builder(ubatch_idx)`, matching upstream's per-ubatch builder selection (needed because MLA builders keep prepared metadata on themselves, and upstream init_attn_backend now creates num_metadata_builders=get_num_ubatches(...) builders).
3. Confirm the existing DBO-disable logic in vllm_ascend/platform.py remains consistent with the new VllmConfig._get_dbo_unsupported_features() gating (which now keys off use_ubatching and VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER) and the new ParallelConfig threshold validation in vllm/config/parallel.py (thresholds must be >= num_ubatches). Since enable_dbo/ubatch_size are zeroed, use_ubatching stays False and none of these fire on Ascend, so no functional change is needed, only verification.
deep_analysis.risk: Low today: DBO is explicitly disabled on Ascend (enable_dbo/ubatch_size reset in check_and_update_config), and every changed upstream signature (ModelState.prepare_attn ubatch_idx, BatchExecutionDescriptor.num_ubatches=1, dispatch/get_batch_descriptor num_ubatches=1, dp_utils new kwargs, attn_utils build_attn_metadata ubatch_idx) is backward-compatible via defaults, so nothing crashes at this commit. Residual risks: (a) interface drift - if part 2 of the DBO work or a future commit enables DBO on NPU (or changes the gating), the stale prepare_attn overrides without ubatch_idx will raise TypeError from UBatchRunner.prepare(), and the hardcoded get_metadata_builder(0) in the Ascend build_attn_metadata will build incorrect/shared-state attention metadata across microbatches; (b) the new DBO branch inside dp_utils.sync_cudagraph_and_dp_padding changes the cross-rank handshake tensor (5->6 slots) and requires every DP rank to reach the same ubatching decision, so DBO must never be half-enabled across DP ranks; (c) UBatchRunner uses torch.cuda.Stream and the moved SMControlContextManager (now in vllm/v1/worker/ubatch_utils.py) which asserts CUDA/ROCm platforms, so if DBO is ever enabled on NPU this path needs an Ascend-native stream/SM-control reimplementation.

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/ops/linear.py — AscendLinearBase.__init__ (line 142) still dispatches via `quant_config.get_quant_method(self, prefix=prefix)`, bypassing the new `resolve_quant_method` used by upstream `LinearBase.__init__`, so online+checkpoint composition never applies to Ascend linear layers

vllm_ascend/quantization/configs/modelopt_mxfp8_config.py — AscendModelOptMxFp8Config is registered under "mxfp8", which is now both a checkpoint method and a member of `_DEFERRED_ONLINE_SHORTHANDS` / `_ONLINE_SHORTHANDS`; the new `get_quant_config` fallbacks can now return vLLM's generic `OnlineQuantizationConfig` instead of this class or the old clear error

vllm_ascend/quantization/configs/modelslim_config.py, compressed_tensors_config.py, fp8_config.py, _310p/quantization/modelslim_config.py — all Ascend QuantizationConfig subclasses now inherit the new `online_quantization_config` class attribute and are reached by `resolve_quant_method`, which calls `get_quant_method(layer, prefix)` positionally (their `tid2eid=None` default keeps this working, but must be preserved)

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit is additive and backward-compatible for existing Ascend flows (no removed symbols are imported by vllm-ascend; `resolve_quant_method` is a behavior-preserving wrapper when `online_quantization_config` is None). Required/validated work:

1. Align Ascend quant dispatch with `resolve_quant_method` (import it from `vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization`):
   - vllm_ascend/ops/linear.py AscendLinearBase.__init__ (line 142) and vllm_ascend/ops/vocab_parallel_embedding.py AscendVocabParallelEmbedding.__init__ (line 96): switch `quant_config.get_quant_method(self, prefix=...)` to `resolve_quant_method(quant_config, self, prefix=...)` so the new online-on-unquantized-layers feature works on Ascend.
   - vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/routed_experts.py AscendRoutedExperts._get_quant_method (lines 504-507): keep passing `tid2eid` but route through `resolve_quant_method`; note upstream `resolve_quant_method` raises ValueError if online quant is requested for an already-checkpoint-quantized layer and returns the checkpoint method otherwise, and it calls `get_quant_method(layer, prefix)` with 2 positional args, so keep `tid2eid=None` as a defaulted kwarg in all Ascend configs (modelslim_config.py line 776, fp8_config.py, compressed_tensors_config.py, modelopt_mxfp8_config.py, _310p modelslim_config.py).

2. Validate the "mxfp8"/"mxfp4" resolution change (vllm/config/quantization.py `_DEFERRED_ONLINE_SHORTHANDS` + `resolve_quantization_config`, and vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_utils.py `get_quant_config`):
   - When `--quantization mxfp8` is used with a checkpoint that has no `quantization_config` metadata / no `hf_quant_config.json`, the code now returns generic `OnlineQuantizationConfig(args=_ONLINE_SHORTHANDS["mxfp8"])` instead of the previous `ValueError("Cannot find the config file for mxfp8")` (or `quant_cls()`). Verify AscendModelOptMxFp8Config still wins for genuinely pre-quantized ModelOpt checkpoints (it does, via the `hf_quant_config`/`hf_overrides` branches), and decide whether the new silent generic-online fallback should be intercepted on NPU.

3. Re-run the modified upstream tests that vllm-ascend CI executes (tests/quantization/test_quantization_config_args.py is already in upstream_config.yaml; also tests/quantization/test_online.py, test_online_mxfp4.py, test_config_utils.py, tests/model_executor/test_eagle_quantization.py). Mock-based quant configs in vllm-ascend tests need `.online_quantization_config = None` (upstream added exactly this in test_eagle_quantization.py) since `resolve_quant_method` reads that attribute off the config.

4. `log_online_quantization` (vllm/model_executor/model_loader/base_loader.py) now dereferences `online_quantization_config` on the checkpoint config; Ascend configs inherit the attribute so no patch needed, but Ascend-specific logging/summary paths should tolerate it.

5. Feature parity decision: to actually support online quantization of unquantized layers in partially pre-quantized checkpoints on NPU (the commit's headline feature), vllm-ascend must ensure the resolved online method classes (vLLM `Mxfp8OnlineLinearMethod`, `Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod`, `Fp8PerTensorOnline*MoEMethod`, etc., now constructed with `moe=FusedMoEConfig` — a breaking constructor change) map onto Ascend ops, or add Ascend-native online method implementations. If not pursued, document that `quantization_config` composition is silently a no-op on Ascend custom layers.
deep_analysis.risk: Low for existing functionality (pure additive change; no import/constructor breakage in code vllm-ascend currently uses — the changed `layer=`→`moe=` constructors and `_Fp8OnlineLinearBase`→`OnlineLinearBase` rename are not referenced by vllm-ascend). Main risks: (1) `--quantization mxfp8` on a float checkpoint now silently builds vLLM's generic CUDA/Triton-based OnlineQuantizationConfig on NPU instead of erroring, which can surface as confusing kernel/load failures rather than a clear config error; (2) because AscendRoutedExperts/AscendLinearBase/AscendVocabParallelEmbedding bypass `resolve_quant_method`, the new online-on-prequantized composition silently won't apply on Ascend, so users may believe layers were online-quantized when they were not, and the upstream conflict detection (ValueError) won't fire either; (3) `resolve_quant_method` calls `get_quant_method(layer, prefix)` with exactly two positional args — if any Ascend config drops the `tid2eid=None` default (or makes it positional-required), model construction breaks.
